# t3.1 — Windows Playwright Chromium Launch Repair

## Summary

The canonical Windows E2E command now loads repository credentials from `.env` and uses the verified system Chrome channel by default. Playwright-managed Chromium remains available as an explicit diagnostic override and still reproduces the environment-only `spawn UNKNOWN` failure.

## Upstream Artifacts Consumed

- `.github/modernize/rearchitecture/artifacts/t2-frontend.md` — established the modularization changes and browser-E2E scope.
- `.github/modernize/rearchitecture/artifacts/t3-tester.md` — recorded the original managed-Chromium launch failure and system Chrome control result.
- `.github/modernize/rearchitecture/team/tester/log.md` — supplied prior serialized-launch evidence and credential-gated flow status.

## Evidence Mapping

- `t2-frontend.md#Test Results` -> canonical unit/build/lint behavior remains green after the test-config change.
- `t3-tester.md#Runtime Verdict` -> the browser blocker was isolated to managed Chromium, not selectors or application behavior.
- `playwright.config.ts#projects` -> Windows defaults to `chrome`; `PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=chromium` explicitly selects the managed browser.
- `playwright.config.ts#dotenv loading` -> only `E2E_EMAIL` and `E2E_PASSWORD` are loaded from `.env` when absent from the process environment.

## Diagnostics

- `node --version`: `v24.19.0`
- `npm --version`: `12.0.2`
- `npx playwright --version`: `1.63.0`
- Playwright cache: revision `1243` managed Chromium executable exists, but Windows process creation still returns `spawn UNKNOWN`.
- System Chrome control: Playwright launches the installed Chrome channel successfully.
- `.env` contains non-empty E2E credential keys; values were loaded in-process and never printed.

## Repair

`playwright.config.ts` now resolves the browser channel as follows:

- Windows with no override: use installed system Chrome.
- `PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=chrome`: use system Chrome explicitly.
- `PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=chromium`: force managed Chromium for diagnosis.
- Non-Windows with no override: preserve Playwright-managed Chromium behavior.

The same config loads only `E2E_EMAIL` and `E2E_PASSWORD` from the repository `.env` when explicit process values are absent. Explicit process values remain authoritative.

No application source, selectors, or feature code changed.
